{{Quote|The Sleek Cruiser Inn on Grand Eucer Street. Room 2222. But let me assure you, my friend, this inn is no sleek cruiser. More like a garbage barge.|Didi Oddo to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
'''Room 2222''' was a room in the [[Sleek Cruiser Inn]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Euceron]], [[Eusebus]]. The thief [[Fligh]] stayed in the room during the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
